purpose: Calculate a fraud score for payments to determine if a payment is suspicious and store the decision.

components.name: payment-events
components.evidence: MSK is the managed Kafka from AWS.

components.name: scoring-engine
components.evidence: This reads each event, applies the rules and the model and produces a decision.

components.name: decisions-db
components.evidence: The engine writes the decision here, together with the customer attributes it used.

components.name: scoring audit log group
components.evidence: The engine writes an audit record for every decision.

flows.evidence: payment-events sends the payment event to the scoring-engine, with customer attributes such as country, device id and the history counters.
The engine writes the risk decision to decisions-db.
The scoring-engine writes an audit record to the scoring audit log group.
